title: L112 — THE SIZE THAT CAME FROM NOWHERE
voice: Two traders enter the same setup at the same price. One sizes from the account balance, and the other sizes from the profit he made an hour ago.
The first position risks what the account can lose, while the second position risks what the last win felt like.
A profit is not capital until it survives a drawdown, because unrealized gains disappear at the same speed they arrived.
The account grew, but the method that grew it did not change its rules.
Size from the balance, never from the last trade. Follow KONGRAVE — the mechanics nobody explains.

caption:
Two traders enter the same setup at the same price. One sizes from the account balance, and the other sizes from the profit he made an hour ago.

The first position risks what the account can lose. The second risks what the last win felt like. A profit is not capital until it survives a drawdown, because unrealized gains disappear at the same speed they arrived.

Size from the balance, never from the last trade.
